identification: Wide live-edge slab, about 45-55 cm x 2.4 m, pale brown with cathedral figure, a check at the bottom end. Colour and grain look more like elm, ash or similar than dark walnut; species not verifiable from photos. Gowans uses 'walnut' loosely (earlier SLAB OF WALNUT lots were described as pale, ring-porous, or purpleheart/macrocarpa).

searches_tried: comps.py (pipeline and work) with walnut slab and live edge slab: Gowans hits only, no resale comps in the database. WebSearch budget was exhausted, so no web resale searches ran (no dealer, Invaluable or Island Specialty Timbers checks). eBay sold listings (live edge walnut / elm slab 2.4m, Australia) and dealer prices would settle resale; not done. Recent Gowans comps show locally about $50-135, so the Armitage-blind guess of $200-600 is unsupported by anything I saw.
chrome_hint: eBay.com.au sold items: 'live edge slab walnut 2400' and 'live edge elm slab' (Australia, sold); also Gumtree/dealer slab prices (e.g. Island Specialty Timbers, Tasmanian slab sellers) for kiln-dried comparable slabs.
viewing_check: Photograph end grain and a cut or planed corner to identify species (walnut is darker chocolate heartwood with open pores; elm/ash is pale with ring-porous grain); check thickness (not visible), moisture/kiln-drying, length, and the split at the bottom end for how far it runs.
